role.name: rest-audit
role.description: Reading of the audit log via REST, without any "all" authorization. This is what a read-only client (e.g. an integration or an AI agent) needs in order to search audit records.

authorization.description: REST-level authorization for the audit search operation.
Model-level authorization to read audit records. It must not contain any object selectors. Together with the REST authorization above this is sufficient; no "all" authorization is needed.
